description: Defines the 'Services' class and related nested classes for managing broadcast services, including scanning, handling tuner notifications, and parsing DVB SDT tables.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages broadcast services, including scanning, service list management, and DVB SDT table processing.

classes.name: Services::Service
classes.description: Represents individual broadcast service information, including service ID, name, and status flags.

classes.name: Services::Sink
classes.description: Handles tuner notifications such as activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Services::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB SDT sections to update service information.

methods.name: Services::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for services.

methods.name: Services::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a service by its ID.

methods.name: Services::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of services.

methods.name: Services::Load
methods.description: Loads service data from DVB SDT tables.
